hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: The count of contiguous ranges with exactly k distinct values equals those with at most k minus those with at most k - 1.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Expand the right pointer while tracking frequency tallies of distinct items in the range.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Shrink the left pointer when the number of distinct items exceeds the limit.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Two linear scans compute atMost(k) and atMost(k - 1) in O(n) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all O(n^2) subarrays with set checks requires O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses frequency counters bounded by the alphabet of distinct elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies the reduction count(k) = atMost(k) - atMost(k - 1).
